union all select 'debate_audit',count(*) from public.debate_v3_audit t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-8aa6554b1f327d03fa1ffdeee5a9fa17'
union all select 'debate_match_versions',count(*) from public.debate_v3_match_versions t where event_id='de-8aa6554b1f327d03fa1ffdeee5a9fa17'
union all select 'debate_ballots',count(*) from public.debate_v3_ballots t join f on t.judge_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-8aa6554b1f327d03fa1ffdeee5a9fa17'
union all select 'debate_votes',count(*) from public.debate_v3_votes t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-8aa6554b1f327d03fa1ffdeee5a9fa17'
union all select 'debate_outbox',count(*) from public.debate_v3_outbox t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-8aa6554b1f327d03fa1ffdeee5a9fa17'
union all select 'debate_uploads',count(*) from public.debate_v3_uploads t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-8aa6554b1f327d03fa1ffdeee5a9fa17'
union all select 'debate_rate_limits',count(*) from public.debate_v3_rate_limits t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text
union all select 'storage_owned',count(*) from storage.objects t join f on t.owner=f.id or t.owner_id=f.id::text or t.name like '%de-8aa6554b1f327d03fa1ffdeee5a9fa17%'
) select clock_timestamp() checked_at,jsonb_object_agg(scope,n) counts from counts;
